## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.

  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

never before. This unique approach leads to exceptional service, clinical expertise, and better
outcomes for all.

[Computer icon]

## Let’s improve outcomes together

Our priority is providing an exceptional experience that puts our patients first. With a focus on
improving clinical outcomes, our high-touch and customized treatment plans allow our pharmacists to
provide an elevated level of service for patients with chronic conditions and rare and orphan
diseases. As a full-service pharmacy, we’re better positioned than other specialty services to build
connections throughout the healthcare continuum that result in the best possible care.
[Flexible Icon]

#### Exceptional Service

That allows our patients easy access to certified specialty pharmacists who are always available to
provide high-touch care.
[Reduce Icon]

#### Clinical Expertise

For patients with rare and orphan diseases. Our long history of being a center of excellence means
they’ll get the best care from our expert pharmacists.
[Improved Icon]

#### Better Outcomes

From adherence programs to clinical protocols, our clinical teams keep patients at the center of
everything we do.

## Delivering value
## at every step

Our full range of specialty pharmacy services bring a new level of service to your patients and the
providers in your network. We provide customized programs that improve patient outcomes using the
following methods:
* Time-saving referrals
* Patient advocacy - Patient assistance programs, alternative foundation funding
* Reimbursement assistance - Benefit investigations, prior authorization assistance
* Customized refill reminders
* Access to limited-distribution medications and devices
* Personal case managers
* Clinical interventions and side effect monitoring
* Medication administration training
* Customized refill reminders, including personal phone calls and digital engagement
* Disease-specific patient education resources
* Patient adherence tracking and reporting
* Package tracking, temperature controlled

## Personalized service.
## Focused care.

Delivering exceptional patient care on a personal level is our biggest priority. Our certified
specialty pharmacists bring deep clinical experience to every patient encounter. We are specialists
in rare and orphan diseases and provide over 100 limited distribution drugs (LDDs) to our patients
through our pharmaceutical manufacture partners. From seamless coordination with physicians to
proactive patient support, we provide personalized collaboration across the care continuum to drive
better outcomes.
[Scientist in protective gear holding a blue pill with gloved hand in laboratory"]

#### Rare Disease Specialists

Focused support for patients who have rare and orphan diseases.

[Close-up of prescription capsules with medicine bottles in background on pharmacy counter"]

#### Access You Can Count On

Limited-distribution provider for a wide range of specialized medications
A direct result of our proactive, personalized care coordination.

[Diverse team of doctors and nurses collaborating in a hospital meeting]

#### Best in class patient care

A direct result of proactive, personalized care coordination results in better outcomes and patient
satisfaction.

Want to connect with VytlOne Specialty Pharmacy or explore opportunities? Get in touch with us
today.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

Whether you need help finding a great shipping quote in minutes or could use help getting in touch
with carriers, Freightquote has the resources and technologies that can help you meet your LTL,
truckload and parcel shipping needs. Our online freight quote tools make the whole shipping process
easier—from finding a carrier to tracking your products.

Freightquote simplifies freight shipping so you can spend time where it matters—running your
business.

With all the options and shipping services that we offer, you can more easily overcome whatever
obstacles are in your way. No matter the size of the shipment or the destination location, discover
what sets us apart from other local freight companies. Explore our freight services, custom
solutions, or get a free freight quote today.

## The Trusted Choice for NextGen NCLEX-RN Coaching in Kerala ®

## //1

## 100% Live NextGen NCLEX-RN Classes

Attend 100% live interactive Zoom classes led by experienced NCLEX-RN educators. Learn through
structured NextGen NCLEX-RN coaching, real-time discussions, concept-based teaching, and clinical
judgment-focused learning designed for international nursing success.

## //2

## NCLEX-RN Classes in Malayalam + English

Master complex NCLEX-RN concepts through Malayalam + English bilingual classes. Our simplified
teaching approach helps nurses across Kerala build strong clinical reasoning, improve confidence,
and prepare effectively for the NextGen NCLEX-RN examination.

## //3

## Free NCLEX-RN QBank & CAT Practice

Eligible students receive free NCLEX-RN QBank access with thousands of practice questions, detailed
rationales, Computer Adaptive Testing (CAT) experience, performance analysis, and exam-oriented
practice to strengthen clinical judgment.

## //4

## 25,000+ NCLEX-RN Success Stories

Trusted by thousands of nurses, MEDLINE ACADEMY®️ has helped build international nursing careers
through structured NextGen NCLEX-RN coaching. With 25,000+ success stories and 100,000+ nurses
trained, we remain committed to first-attempt success.

## //5

## Government Registered Trademark®️

MEDLINE ACADEMY®️ is a Government Registered Trademark under Class 41 (Trade Mark No. 6201036),
officially recognized by the Trade Marks Registry, Government of India for NCLEX-RN coaching,

California. We combine conventional diagnostic testing with evidence-based natural treatments to

food sensitivities, stress and fatigue, inflammation, immune system dysfunction, and poor digestion

into your bloodstream to be utilized by the body — allowing for 100% absorption.

medicine][51], [mental health and mood support][52], [supportive cancer care][53], [gastrointestinal
health services][54], [hormone therapy][55] and [pediatrics][56].

Uncover cost savings, improve efficiency, gain supply chain control, and support compliance.

[Learn More][41]
* Robotics
* Smart Devices
* Software

### Robotics

Reducing the potential for human error

Removing human interaction from medication management processes supports safety and efficiency,
while automating manual tasks allows staff to focus on higher value activities.

### Smart Devices

Streamlining workflows for safer, more efficient patient care

Designed to improve workflows, while closing gaps in safety and inventory visibility, Omnicell’s
smart devices enable clinicians to spend less time managing medications and more time caring for
patients.

### Software

Providing visibility and insights to the pharmacy supply chain

Intelligent software solutions offer greater visibility to medication inventory, providing powerful
data insights to optimize the pharmacy supply chain to reduce medication waste and realize cost
savings.

### Services

Maximizing value for your pharmacy technology

Expert technicians and strategists serve as an extension of your pharmacy operations to support
improved efficiency, deliver accelerated time-to-value, and enhance patient care.

# Infusion Therapies and Technologies

Empower your team to deliver safe, efficient care with our connected infusion systems, IV fluids and
clinical nutrition solutions, all backed by our broad supply chain network.

[A clinician wearing gloves and a mask hanging up a IV bag while looking behind her]

## Explore Our Infusion Therapies and Technologies

Our infusion therapies and technologies encompass a comprehensive range of products, including
infusion systems and accessories, clinical nutrition solutions and essential IV solutions trusted by
healthcare professionals worldwide.

[Healthcare worker hangs a bag of Clinolipid on a stand]

### Clinical Nutrition

Address malnutrition with clinical nutrition solutions designed to support individualized therapy,
operational efficiency and improved patient outcomes.

[Baxter Novum Syringe Pump - Barcode Scan]

### Infusion Systems and Accessories

Standardize infusion delivery with systems and accessories designed to support safe medication
administration, efficient workflows and bedside confidence.

[Healthcare worker hangs an IV bag on a stand]

### IV Solutions

Support everyday care with a broad IV solutions portfolio designed to meet common medication and
hydration needs across acute care settings.

## Connect Smarter with DeviceBridge

Unlock integration for your Baxter devices and applications. **DeviceBridge** is our unified,
cloud-based gateway that securely connects **IQ Enterprise**, infusion pumps, vital signs monitors
and smart beds to your hospital’s EHR and IT systems. With robust security, common data exchange,
and user management features, **DeviceBridge** simplifies connectivity and scales to meet your
needs, with maintenance and updates handled by Baxter.

## Why Choose Baxter

Count on Baxter for reliable IV fluid and nutrition solution supply—no matter the challenge. Our
manufacturing and distribution teams are ready to deliver, every day. 

### #1 in Manufacturing Capacity

Six IV fluid manufacturing plants are located in Canada and the U.S., more than all other IV
suppliers combined.¹

### Broad Distribution Network

Six strategically-located mega-distribution centers are in the U.S. for rapid, reliable delivery for
hospitals and clinics.

### Proven Track Record

We put nearly 100 years of quality and innovation expertise into each of the one million+ IV bags we
make every day, right here in the U.S.

### $2.5+ Billion Invested¹

We’ve invested over $2.5 billion to expand our manufacturing network—so you can count on continuous
supply and rapid response, even in challenging times.

### A Range of Trusted Options

With Baxter, you can choose the IV product that fits your needs. Baxter’s **Viaflex** containers
have an extensive history of safe, effective care for decades, and we’re leading the transition to
DEHP-free options in full compliance with U.S. regulations. Our evolving portfolio ensures you’re
always ready for what’s next, with safety and choice at the forefront.
